header.name: PracticeCrystalSimBot BP
header.description: Crystal PvP practice bot as SimulatedPlayer. Requires Beta APIs experiment ON. v0.10.0: 1) Improved A* pathfinding (reuses existing open paths/stairs first, straight 4-cardinal climbing & straight staircase mining instead of diagonal corner-clipping); 2) Active Shield equipping & guarding (equips shield in mainhand + sneaks against projectiles, enemy bow/crossbow aim, and aerial mace/melee dives); 3) Hard preset defaults all cooldowns to 0 (minimum) with surroundTactic OFF; 4) Elytra-Mace aerial pursuit when enemy is high up with Slow Falling. Includes the 0.9.x stability line: per-bot exception isolation + instant stale-target invalidation (no freeze when a bot is removed mid-fight), hard-preset debug logging ON, and persistent-log mirroring to the content log for the viewer.
